Message.Subject: Cascade Web Services — Q2 hosting invoice (tax label looks wrong)

Body.Content:
Hi Lakefront AP,

Please treat the printed AMOUNT as authoritative — we will reissue with the correct LABEL on the next billing run. Flag it on your side too so the GL posts to the right tax account.

Thanks,
Devon Ng · Cascade Web Services Ltd.
